project.title: Synergistic improvement of biological hydrogen production from waste activated sludge by sodium citrate combined with Fenton oxi-dation pretreatment
project.description: Low hydrolysis efficiency and rapid hydrogen consumption by homoacetogens, sulfate-reducing bacteria, and hydrogenotrophic methanogens are the two major bottlenecks restricting dark fermentative hydrogen production from waste activated sludge (WAS). This study proposed an SC-Fenton combined pretreatment strategy based on sodium citrate (SC) and Fenton oxidation to simultaneously overcome these bottlenecks. Under the optimal conditions, the cumulative hydrogen yield increased from 1.33 to 23.48 mL/g VSS, showing a remarkable synergistic enhancement. Metatranscriptomic analysis revealed a bidirectional regulatory pattern: hydrogen-producing functional genes were significantly upregulated, whereas hydrogen-consuming or competing metabolic genes were markedly downregulated. This study provides a mechanistically supported pretreatment strategy for efficient dark fermentative hydrogen production from WAS.
